data.name: Amina
data.gender_notes: Amina is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root أ-م-ن (ʾ-m-n), 'to be safe, trustworthy'. Amīna means 'trustworthy, faithful'. Its root is أ-م-ن (ʾ-m-n). Borne by Āmina bint Wahb, mother of the Prophet ﷺ. Amina is a Arabic name meaning “Trustworthy; faithful; safe”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Amina expresses “Trustworthy; faithful; safe”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root أ-م-ن (ʾ-m-n), 'to be safe, trustworthy'. Amīna means 'trustworthy, faithful'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amina total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
